_note: LIVE ERPNext binding. Tools are served by lib/mcp/hvgerp-adapter-server.mjs, which calls the pinned @hvgllc/hvgerp-mcp@3.7.0 and exposes only the business tools below: 25 reads plus four owner-enabled writes (customer-bill and purchase-order drafts and submits). The purchase-order writes (erp.po.create_draft, erp.po.submit) are owner-enabled: draft for Dave, submit only for nammaops-po-submit with the owner PIN. Select with NAMMAOPS_BINDING=config/nammaops/binding.hvgerp.json.
data_label: Live ERPNext Cloud (demo store; records marked NAMMAOPS-SEED are synthetic demo data)

server.name: ERPNext Cloud (read-only adapter over hvgerp-mcp 3.7.0)
server.description: Narrow read-only adapter. Credentials come from ERPNEXT_URL, ERPNEXT_API_KEY and ERPNEXT_API_SECRET in the server environment only.

erp.po.create_draft._note: Owner-enabled 2026-11-11. Creates a DRAFT purchase order only (no accounts or stock effect). Granted to Dave only.

erp.po.submit._note: Owner-enabled 2026-11-11. Runs only for the nammaops-po-submit principal with an owner approval (PIN) bound to the exact draft, call and session.

erp.sales_invoice.create_draft._note: Owner-enabled 2026-11-08. Creates a DRAFT customer bill only (no accounts or stock effect). Granted to Frank only.

erp.sales_invoice.submit._note: Owner-enabled 2026-11-08. Runs only for the nammaops-bill-submit principal with an owner approval (PIN) bound to the exact draft, call and session.
